referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Included are the hydropower electricity production in Switzerland, the transmission network and direct emissions to air (ozone and N2O). Electricity losses are accounted for.
referenceFunction.localName: Electricity, high voltage, production from hydro power, at grid
referenceFunction.name: Electricity, high voltage, production from hydro power, at grid

geography.text: Data apply to public and self producers. Geographical classification according to IEA. Ozone- and NO2-emission factors are based on published measurements made in various countries. Assumptions for transmission network, losses and emissions are based on UTCE data.

technology.text: Average technology used to transmit and distribute electricity. Includes underground and overhead lines. Electricity production according to related datasets
